name: Egyptian fractions: number of solutions to 1 = 1/x_1 + ... + 1/x_n in positive integers x_1 < ... < x_n.
comment: All denominators in the expansion 1 = 1/x_1 + ... + 1/x_n are bounded by A000058(n-1), i.e., 0 < x_1 < ... < x_n < A000058(n-1). Furthermore, for a fixed n, x_i <= (n+1-i)*(A000058(i-1)-1). - _Max Alekseyev_, Oct 11 2012
If on the other hand, x_k need not be unique, see A002966. - _Robert G. Wilson v_, Jul 17 2013
